why: The one PHP-shaped invention risk (§3.2): `Job::run()` calls bare `helper()`, and `App\Svc\helper` does not exist — only the truly global `\helper` (declared with no namespace, in another file) does, and PHP falls back to it at runtime. Guessing that fallback would be a fabrication if the namespaced function existed and just happened to be declared elsewhere; the extractor never guesses it, so this is a predicted recall miss, not a false positive. `local()` in the same file/namespace is the control that must still hit.

known_gaps.why: PREDICTED BEFORE SCORING. The global-namespace fallback for a bare function call is never guessed (§3.2) — an edge to `php:App.Svc.helper` would be a false positive (no such function exists), so this stays a recall miss instead.
